graph.degree_definition: number of distinct pre-T0 reviewers after excluding query user
graph.common_history_graph_fraction: fraction of distinct valid last-50 history items with GLOBAL pre-T0 degree>0, including own prior reviews; candidate-independent factor-knownness control
graph.normalised_path_strength: mean |R(h) intersection R(c)|/sqrt(deg(h)*deg(c)) over graph-supported nonself history items; zero when unsupported
graph.supported_history_fraction: fraction of all nonself valid history items with at least one shared other reviewer with candidate
graph.metadata_fractions: matching nonself known history labels / nonself known history labels; missing candidate or empty denominator gives zero
graph.metadata_neighbour_availability: at least one other pre-T0 product with the same known leaf/store, regardless of current query user
